verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs say it is a drop-in npm replacement that can be pointed at any existing project with "no migration, no rewrites, no lockfile gymnastics". Community users report migrating large yarn and lerna/npm monorepos, though one needed the --shamefully-hoist workaround. The evidence shows no dedicated import or conversion command, and no migration guide for converting an existing lockfile or config. Missing for 10: documented lockfile import/conversion tooling (e.g. from package-lock.json or yarn.lock), a step-by-step migration guide from npm/yarn, and documented handling of compatibility issues like hoisting during migration.
